def apply_change_to_nodes(self, nodes, text, pos):
    try:
        nodes.remove(None)
    except:
        pass
    # sort nodes by priority
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda node: node.priority)
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        # try to change node and continue with the next one if the change isn't valid
        result = self.change_node(node, text, pos)
        if result:
            return
    # if none of the nodes matches, insert a new node
    # XXX split the current selected node if cursor is inside text
    if sorted_nodes and pos > sorted_nodes[0].position and pos < sorted_nodes[0].position + len(sorted_nodes[0].symbol.name):
        # Split the current node
        current_node = sorted_nodes[0]
        left_text = current_node.symbol.name[:pos - current_node.position - 1]
        right_text = current_node.symbol.name[pos - current_node.position - 1:]
        new_left_node = TextNode(Terminal(left_text), -1, [], current_node.position)
        new_right_node = TextNode(Terminal(right_text), -1, [], current_node.position + len(left_text))
        new_left_node.regex = current_node.regex
        new_left_node.priority = current_node.priority
        new_left_node.lookup = current_node.lookup
        # Insert the new nodes
        current_node.parent.insert_after_node(current_node, new_left_node)
        current_node.parent.insert_after_node(new_left_node, new_right_node)
    else:
        new_node = TextNode(Terminal(text), -1, [], pos)
        new_node.regex = self.getPL().regex(text)
        new_node.priority = self.getPL().priority(text)
        new_node.lookup = self.getPL().name(text)
        # add to left node
        sorted_nodes[0].parent.insert_after_node(sorted_nodes[0], new_node)
